peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 13.1% below its local comparables; 23 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (88.3): 5.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 356 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 37.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 4-bedroom: median $5,680,000 ($2,551 psf, 2,120–2,594 sq ft; 6 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,937 psf (range $2,104–4,290); 13.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $859,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard Boulevard MRT about 390 m, Orchard MRT about 460 m; closer than 306 of 551 similar developments (the same as 13). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 1,600 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 240 m), more than 419 of 551 similar developments (the same as 42); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 1,560 m; nearest park Sbg Lc Zone 1 (Tnc) about 860 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 240 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 490 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 690 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 800 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,410 m; The Giverny Residences, 2 new sales, about 1,500 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,650 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,690 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 381 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,275 new sales and 1,191 resales (2,466 purchases); new sales were 51.7% of these purchases. Subsales (32) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,310 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,440 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,191 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 445 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,191 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,289 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.6%). Planning-area private resales −58.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
